# AttachmentRelationship

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The relationship an embedded file has to the PDF that carries it, written as the `/AFRelationship` entry of the file's `/Filespec` dictionary (PDF 2.0 §7.11.3, ISO 19005-3 for PDF/A-3). Associated files are the mechanism e-invoicing standards (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X) use to attach the source XML alongside the rendered invoice.

The enum values are the PDF names verbatim so the serializer can emit `/${relationship}` directly, keeping output identical to the .NET peer.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Unspecified`: Relationship unknown or not covered by the other values. Default.
- `Source`: The source the visible content was derived from (ZUGFeRD invoice XML).
- `Data`: Data used to generate the visible content (Factur-X invoice XML).
- `Alternative`: An alternative representation of the PDF's content.
- `Supplement`: Supplementary material for the PDF's content.
- `EncryptedPayload`: An encrypted payload for which the PDF is a wrapper.
- `FormData`: Data associated with an AcroForm.
- `Schema`: A schema definition for other associated files.
